message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Publish Windows Bundle

on:
  push:
    branches:
    - master
    tags:
    - v*

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

# Let a tagged release build run to completion instead of being superseded by a
# later push to the same ref. Different refs (master vs. a tag) never contend.
concurrency:
  group: publish-windows-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    environment: azuresigning
    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - name: Setup NodeJS
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '14'
    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          node_modules
          ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('package.json', 'package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - name: Setup Env
      run: |
        npm i
        npm i -g nexe@4.0.0-rc.7
    - name: Retrieve the metadata and decode it to a file
      env:
        AZURESIGNING_METADATA: ${{ secrets.AZURESIGNING_METADATA }}
      run: |
        echo $AZURESIGNING_METADATA | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP\metadata.json"
      shell: bash
    - name: Azure login
      uses: azure/login@v1
      with:
        client-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
        tenant-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
        subscription-id: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}
    - name: Build bundle
      run: |
        npm run winbundle -- --signtool-path "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\10.0.26100.0\x64\signtool.exe" --azure-signing-metadata "%RUNNER_TEMP%\metadata.json"
      shell: cmd
    - name: Upload Bundle File
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: Bundle
        path: dist\*.zip
        retention-days: 3
    - name: Upload Bundle to Release
      uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
      if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
      with:
        repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        file: dist/*.zip
        file_glob: true
        tag: ${{ github.ref }}
        overwrite: true
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm i` (plus a pinned global `nexe` install) on every run with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and package.json/package-lock.json can serve as cache inputs. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) is a reviewed pattern with reported VM-time benefit and no contraindication here: no equivalent cache exists, and the cached content is dependency downloads rather than unchecked build outputs. Adding an `actions/cache` step for `node_modules` and `~/.npm`, keyed on the lockfiles, keeps the install step and all build/publish coverage intact while speeding warm runs. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or publishing/deployment operations are added, and no new privileged network access is introduced beyond the existing official actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
